neighbours.label: the first digit of a number that continues a series of figures (shares, prices, time ranges, table values)
fire: Coal supplied 40% of the power, gas 35%, and renewables 25% last year.
Tickets cost $12 for adults, $8 for students and $5 for children.
The clinic is open from 8:00 to 12:30 and again from 14:00 to 18:00.
Scores for the three rounds were 71, 68 and 73.
The rates were 4.25% in May, 4.50% in June and 4.75% in July.
Monthly costs: rent $950, food $420, transport $130, total $1,500.
The heights measured 152 cm, 147 cm and 160 cm respectively.
In the vote, 312 members said yes, 94 said no and 23 abstained.
quiet: Coal supplied most of the power, with gas and renewables making up the rest.
Tickets cost less for students, and children get in for a small fee.
The clinic is open in the morning and again for a few hours after lunch.
Scores for the three rounds were all close to par.
The rates rose a little every month from May through July.
Monthly costs include rent, food and transport, which add up quickly.
The heights measured were all a little above average for the group.
In the vote, most members said yes, a few said no and some abstained.
